'''Nafjan T'dell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] served as a [[Mining/Legends|miner]] aboard the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Omen]]'' during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="paragon" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''Omen'' was bumped off course while jumping to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]] and crashed on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> T'dell survived the disaster, and eventually he and the other remaining ''Omen'' crewmembers made their way to civilization, where they took their place as rulers of the world. In [[4992 BBY]], T'dell had a daughter, [[Ebya T'dell|Ebya]], with another Human survivor, a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] named [[Kanika T'dell|Kanika]]. Both Nafjan and Kanika were acquainted with [[Seelah Korsin]], a prominent member of the Kesh Sith [[Lost Tribe of Sith|society]] who, in [[4985 BBY]], examined Ebya to determine whether she would eventually be allowed to [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduce]].<ref name="paragon" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nafjan T'dell received his first and only mention in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2010]] [[eBook]], ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''.<ref name="paragon" />
